svg.aria-label: Codevira architecture: entry points, the codevira binary, the two in-repo stores, and the global home
svg.title: Codevira architecture — where things run and where data lives
svg.desc: A tall light sheet in four grouped bands. Band one, ENTRY POINTS, holds five cards: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor drawn with a dashed blue border because its entry is not --project-dir pinned, Antigravity, and a greyed-out Codex and Copilot card that gets no server at all. A separate GIT card sits to its right. Blue lines carry stdio MCP down into band two; a single amber bus gathers the hook invocations. Band two, ONE BINARY, is anchored by a blue-to-violet gradient card for the MCP server, beside the engine card (7 policies, 5 event types) and a CLI and indexer card, with a note that codevira serve is a separate opt-in process. Slate lines then fan down into band three. On the left, IN THE REPO stacks the .codevira canonical memory card, its per-machine or shared caveat, the .codevira-cache card and the generated AGENTS.md and .gitattributes card. On the right, GLOBAL HOME lists global.db, device_id and update_check.json, and projects slash slug. Between them a dashed violet hexagon, get_data_dir(), points left to in-repo and right to centralized. A legend names the four arrow kinds and a footnote rail carries the caveats.
svg.text: Codevira architecture — where things run, and where data lives
setup configures exactly these four MCP clients. Windsurf and Gemini-CLI are not targets.

g.text: stdio, unpinned — binds via cwd / MCP roots

svg.text: codevira init --shared keeps it git-tracked for teams.
Dashed blue = the Cursor exception: its entry is bare (args: []), unpinned, and is not written by register-all.
Codex/Copilot get no server — their whole integration is the generated AGENTS.md. codevira serve requires the [http] extra.
.codevira/ redirects to the main worktree; .codevira-cache/ does not. git pre-commit enforcement is file-level — it sets no proposed_diff.
Claude Code's 5 hooks: SessionStart · UserPromptSubmit · PreToolUse · PostToolUse · Stop.
